name: Can an AI property valuation account for home renovations or unique features?

mainEntity.name: Can an AI property valuation account for home renovations or unique features?

acceptedAnswer.text: An AI property valuation can account for some renovations or unique features if they are accurately documented in public records, such as updated square footage or additions. However, it often struggles to fully capture the qualitative value of high-end finishes, custom remodels, or specific aesthetic improvements that aren't quantifiable in standard databases. A human expert can better assess the impact of such details on value, especially in areas with diverse property styles like Coral Gables or Coconut Grove. You may need to provide specific details to a human agent.
acceptedAnswer.description: AI valuations can incorporate documented renovations but may not fully capture the value of qualitative upgrades; human input is often needed for unique features.
